steps.diagnostic: Pinned source, npm ci, and TypeScript build completed.
npm audit reported 8 vulnerabilities: 4 high, 3 moderate, and 1 low.

freecad_create_box failed with spawn /Applications/FreeCAD.app/Contents/Resources/bin/python ENOENT. The bridge accepted FREECAD_CMD=/usr/bin/freecadcmd for logging but derived the executable from a hard-coded macOS application root.
No model or export existed to send through Wright after the backend failed.
The disposable probe container exited and was removed.

reopen_when: A release fixes non-macOS headless startup, resolves dependency-audit findings, and passes an independently checked CAD export through Wright.
